posts.meta_description:
22K likes, 307 comments - sachintendulkar on October 29, 2026: "I had an idea for a shoe for fast bowlers that we could explore at @tenxyouworld. With @thevarunmayya, I used Astra to see how we could bring it to life.

What I enjoyed was being able to talk through the details, change things along the way and see the idea take shape as a 3D model.

It’s still a prototype, but quite something to see an idea in your head become something you can look at from every angle.

Fast bowlers, what would you add?

#partnership".

203K likes, 766 comments - sachintendulkar on October 9, 2026: "In sport, you can prepare as much as you want. Once you step onto the field, you make the game your own. That’s been one of my favourite things about this first year of TEN x YOU. Seeing people do exactly that.

One year down. Plenty more to play for.

And we’ll Never Stop Playing. ❤️".

792K likes, 704 comments - sachintendulkar on October 8, 2026: "We often associate courage with moments of action. But I’ve come to realise that there is another kind of courage. The discipline to be prepared, the strength to stay focused and the willingness to put the nation before yourself, every single day.

To stand alongside the men and women of @indianairforce is something I hold with great pride. Happy Indian Air Force Day. Jai Hind! 🇮🇳".
